verdict.rationale: Neon has a first-party docs page titled "Neon Read Replicas", so the product appears to ship read replicas. However, the pack holds only the page title, with no detail on how replicas are added or behave. Nothing in the evidence documents high-availability or failover behavior. missing for 10: documented content on creating and using read replicas, documented HA and failover behavior (automatic failover, recovery times, guarantees), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can add read replicas and rely on documented high-availability and failover behavior
